brief.vibe: A printed research note on cream paper: Newsreader serif, hairline rules, footnote superscripts, mono datelines, Prussian blue stamps; it reads like a bound committee memo.
brief.hero: Magazine cover story cast as a research note: a left column of serif H1, standfirst and paragraph with the stamp button beneath, and on the right the five translucent sheets stack in depth over a black and white desk photograph.
brief.type: Newsreader for headings and prose, Spline Sans Mono for figures, datelines and small caps nav; set piece is footnotes that walk down hairline leaders into the table.
brief.palette: Light paper field (F6F3ED), ink, greys, one Prussian blue accent for stamps, links and the button.
brief.motion: The Collation: a focus pull through five translucent sheets on scroll; ruled lines draw the loader; hairline steps on hover; platen press on click; everything restrained and editorial.
brief.speech: Three word H1 with a comma and a period; CTAs "Purchase a Plan" and "Subscribe to Research"; sections named as noun phrases and a numbered 01 to 05 list; blog titles as short "The X" noun phrases; sceptical analyst voice that names what would break it.
brief.rhythm: Folio pages with masthead rules: a cover, a numbered list, a comparison table, a type wall, three plan cards, every section a ruled sheet.
